spec.spec:
Increase the starting grid from five racers to six on the oval. The new car is the same model and runs under the same rules as the other racers, with no special abilities and no change to the bots, HUD, gates or scoring.

- Give the sixth car its own starting slot on the grid. It must not overlap any other car.
- Colour it from the style bible's accent colours. Use one not already used by the other five cars, for example Rose if it is free.
- The kernel's lap, position and timer display must cover all six cars without redrawing it.
- Keep races at three laps and about a minute long.
spec.design:
# Design: Sixth Racer

This is a grid-size change, not a new mechanic. I read `game/` and `kernel/` and did not run `check.sh`. The gate and overlap reasoning below is from reading the code.

## 1. Mechanics
- Set `racers: 6` in `TUNING` in `game/tuning.ts`. This is the only number that changes.
- `game/index.ts` already reads `TUNING.racers` into `game.racers`, so the kernel will pass six `RacerSetup`s.
- Physics, bump rules, drafting, laps (3) and scoring stay as they are. Car 6 gets no special handling.
- The existing grid formula gives car index 5 its own slot. Rows are 3 centre-line indexes apart, about 60 units. The stagger inside a row is 1 index, about 20 units. The lateral offset is ±0.4 × `halfWidth`, about ±37 units.

| Car | Row | Index | Side |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | -3 | left |
| 1 | 0 | -4 | right |
| 2 | 1 | -6 | left |
| 3 | 1 | -7 | right |
| 4 | 2 | -9 | left |
| 5 | 2 | -10 | right |

- Car 5 is about 200 units behind the line. That still sits on the straight, because the start line is 24 points (about 480 units) past the oval's seam.
- Car 5 is more than 60 units from every other car. Contact needs under 30 (`carRadius × 2`), so nothing overlaps.
- The `touching` key is `i*8+j`. With six cars `j` is at most 5, so keys stay unique.
- The Builder should not change the grid code.

## 2. On screen
- `PALETTE.cars[5]` is already Rose `#ff8fc7`. Cars 0–4 use Tomato, Amber, Sky, Lilac and Mint, so Rose is free and gives six distinct colours.
- `PALETTE.cars` also holds Chalk and `#9aa3ad`, a grey that is not in the style bible. Trim the array to exactly the six accent colours so no car can ever be drawn off-palette.
- `render.ts` already draws every car in `s.cars` with `PALETTE.cars[i % length]` plus a name label, so it needs no change.
- The kernel's lap, position and timer display reads `observe` and `status`, which are already generic over the car count.

## 3. Bots
- Nothing changes. `observe` already lists every other car in `rivals`, which is now five entries.
- `ahead` stays on the centre line.
- `actionReady` stays `false`, because there is no action.

## 4. Gates
- **Beginner finishes:** low risk. Six beginners in traffic means slightly more bumping. A bump costs 6% of speed, only on the first tick of contact, and nothing blocks a car from finishing.
- **Expert beats beginner:** low risk. The mixed race becomes 3 experts and 3 beginners, with the same physics, so skill still decides it.
- **Lead changes:** low risk, and probably better. More cars on the same track means more passing. Car 5 starts last.
- **Race length:** unchanged at three laps, since nothing in the physics changes.
- **Performance:** O(n²) collision and drafting checks go from 10 to 15 pairs. That is negligible.
- **Determinism:** nothing random is added.
- **If a gate fails:** if lead changes dip below the parent's, the first lever is to widen the row spacing from 3 to 4 indexes. Don't touch the bots.

## 5. Files
- `game/tuning.ts`: set `racers: 5` to `racers: 6`, and trim `PALETTE.cars` to `["#ff5a3c", "#ffc233", "#3fb8ff", "#b59cff", "#7be0a4", "#ff8fc7"]`.
- `game/index.ts`, `game/render.ts`, `game/track.ts`: no change.
- After the edit, run `sh check.sh`. All gates should pass, and the close-racing value should be at least the parent's.
acceptance: Six cars appear on the starting grid, each in a distinct slot with no overlap.
All six cars have visibly different colours, all taken from the style bible palette.
Every car, the player's included, can complete three laps, and a race still ends with six classified finishers.
The simulation replays identically from the same seed.
The median race stays between 20 and 180 seconds, and a tick costs under 1 ms with six cars.
The node passes the beginner-finish and skill-matters gates, and its close-racing result is no worse than its parent's.
